messages:
julia: Noticing a big uptick in SAST alerts after this morning's RBAC tweak for the keystore reader. ~110 findings in infra repo. Most look like the sealed secret token pattern. Anyone else?
omar: Yep saw it. DAST didn't change but SAST regex is tripping on the new sealed format. Sample: 
```n infra/helm/templates/values.yaml:88
flag: possible-aws-key
match: AKIAZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ
context: value is 'sealed:v2:AKIA...'
```
scanner-bot: scan report id=208900 auto-uploaded: https://scans.internal/208900 (redacted). Reaction :mag_right:.
kevin: That sealed:v2 prefix is introduced by sealed-secrets 2.1. Our detector assumes raw tokens. Short-term: we should suppress these hits scoped to infra/helm/* and attach verifiable evidence.
julia: Agreed. Also need to confirm nothing actually leaked: request KMS decrypt audit for principal svc-keystore-ci between 2026-03-22T02:00Z-02:20Z. Who can pull logs?
omar: I can run the audit query. Will include request id list.
ops-qa: Proposal: create temporary suppression rule in ruleset-v3 with 48h TTL, include evidence tar, and add a follow-up task to update regex to ignore sealed:v2.
kevin: For regex: negative lookbehind for 'sealed:v2:' plus boundary should work. Example: `(?<!sealed:v2:)\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b`. We should add a unit test against our corpus.
julia: Can we also update the scanner's policy engine to treat values read from helm templates that contain 'sealed:' as low-confidence by default? That would stop noise for all cloud key prefixes.
omar: Good idea. Will file an issue: https://git.internal/scanner/issue/7890 (ops: ignore-sealed-values).
scanner-bot: suppression PR template filled: author=@kevin, justification="pattern matches sealed-secret encoding after keystore RBAC change", expires=48h, evidence_url=https://tickets.internal/SEC-1299/evidence.tar.gz.
kevin: Opening suppression PR now: https://git.internal/scanner-configs/pulls/512
julia: Omar - any decrypt events?
omar: Query results: no decrypt events for principal svc-keystore-ci during window. I attached the audit snippet to the ticket. No cleartext seen.
ops-qa: Ran quick local scan with patched regex: noisy hits dropped 110 -> 2. The 2 remaining are true positives. Will mark suppression and follow-up for rule change.
julia: Please add one-liner to incident runbook: "If SAST spikes after keystore/RBAC change, check sealed-secret encodings and KMS decrypt audit before escalating."\e kevin: Done, pushed runbook update in docs/playbooks/sdlc-scans.md
julia: Thanks team. Closing this thread when suppression PR merges and audit snippet attached to SEC-1299. :white_check_mark:
